Commentary.Commentary: So with this mouth-watering clash, it is England Under-19 who go through and they will wait just like us to see who will meet them in the finals. India Under-19 will take on Australia Under-19 in the second Semi-Final on 2nd February at 6:30 pm IST (1 pm GMT). But as usual, the build-up will begin much early. So do join us. Until then, goodbye and take care.

Tom Prest, the victorious skipper of England Under-19, says that they were put under pressure but they did not expect it to get that tight as it did but their bowlers did well in the end to defend the score. Applauds Joshua Boyden by saying that he was brilliant under pressure. Mentions that it was a brave call to bat first and they did well to go past the 200-run mark. He says that they did well with the ball and Tom Aspinwall did a good job of hitting the hard lengths as it wasn't easy for the batters to get under those kind of deliveries.

Suliman Safi, the skipper of Afghanistan, says that it is a very difficult time for them. Tells that they had momentum on their side but are disappointed to end up on the losing side. Says that winning and losing is a part of the game and credits England Under-19 for the way they played. Mentions that the momentum shifted when they lost the wicket of Noor Ahmad.

GEORGE BELL IS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that when he got out to bat, he tried to keep it steady for a while and wanted to take it deep. Applauds Alex Horton by saying that he played a great knock. Tells that it was challenging to play against Afghanistan Under-19 spinners and they had a plan to target their pace bowlers. Mentions that they stayed calm as a team and credits their skipper for the way he handled the situation when they were under pressure at the end.
... The Presentation ...

Earlier in the day, Afghanistan bowlers did a good job but they let the momentum slip away at the fag end and that helped England post 231 in 47 overs. Afghanistan gave a good fight but fell short in the end.

England bowlers had a small target to defend and they did well to take it till the end. They started with a wicket in the very first over but after that things dried up. There were some sloppy fielding and dropped catches as well but some exceptional bowling in the death, especially from Rehan Ahmed who took beating earlier, helped England advance further. Other than James Sales, it was a good performance from the bowling compartment.

Afghanistan were off to a superb start despite losing Nangeyalia Kharote for a duck. Mohammad Ishaq and Allah Noor built a partnership of 93 runs and things were looking pretty easy for Afghanistan. Ishaq was sold short through a run out and then there was flurry of wickets later. Two wickets in quick succession and they needed another big partnership. Abdul Hadi and Bilal Ahmad did just that and brought back life into the game, they posted a 50-run partnership and then it was the cameo of Noor Ahmad which took Afghanistan much closer. The game was very close but the Afghans failed to get over the line in the end.

This is the 44th over when everything was happening. The first ball where Thomas took the catch off Sales delivery and as England were celebrating it, the umpire called it as a no ball. Ecstasy turned into agony for England as Afghanistan took 20 runs off the over. It was a matter of who had the nerves now to take their team into the finals and it turned out to be England who did that job well. Pheww...This game was swinging like a pendulum.

ENGLAND UNDER- 19 ARE INTO THE FINALS OF THE ICC MEN'S U-19 WORLD CUP 2022 AFTER 24 YEARS! What a mouth-watering clash this was. As we write, the staff and England players are over the moon as they enjoy the moment. Heartbreak for Afghanistan who were so, so close but failed to get over the line. Commiserations to Afghanistan who showed an incredible fight until the end but came second best against the favorites of this game.

SWING AND A MISS! THERE IT IS! Joshua Boyden SEALS THE DEAL! Another slower ball, into the wicket, around middle. Abdul Hadi skips down the track to slog but he fails to get any bat on it. England Under-19 win by 15 runs (DLS) and they are through to the finals of the ICC Men's U-19 World Cup 2022!
Back of a length, around middle. Naveed Zadran whips it to the leg side and hands the strike back to Abdul Hadi.
On a length, around middle. Abdul Hadi drills it towards long on and takes a single this time.
Play and a miss! A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Abdul Hadi skips down and looks to heave it to the leg side but he misses. 18 runs needed off 3 balls now.
Fuller in length, outside off. Abdul Hadi lets it be thinking that it is a wide. But it was inside the tramline.
Full ball, outside off. Abdul Hadi drills it towards long off and doesn't take a run.
Brave short though from the tail ender! This is full and on middle. Naveed Zadran reverse hits it over covers but does not take a single. So Hadi will be not on the strike.
Naveed Zadran is the last man in.

OUT! TIMBER!  Bilal Sami goes for a golden duck and Rehan Ahmed says what pressure? He is on a Hat-Trick here. This is full and around off, googly as well. Bilal Sami gets low and looks to slog-sweep it but gets beaten and the ball tuns back in and rattles the stumps. Hat-Trick ball coming up.
Who walks out? It is Bilal Sami.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! This was a flatter ball, shorter in length, around off. Izharulhaq Naveed hangs back and pulls hard but he fails to get the desired distance and hits it straight to James Sales at deep mid-wicket who takes a good catch just in front of the ropes. Afghanistan Under-19 are losing their way out in the middle.
Commentary.Howout: c James Sales b Rehan Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: NOT OUT! A googly, on a length, outside off and spinning in late. Izharulhaq Naveed looks to block but the ball beats his inside edge. Alex Horton behind the sticks grabs the ball and whips the bails off. He appeals but the TV umpire confirms that Naveed had his foot grounded.
A stumping appeal! The replay shows the back foot was inside the crease.
Tossed up, around leg. Abdul Hadi sweeps it towards short fine leg for a run.
Izharulhaq Naveed walks out.

OUT! TAKEN! WOW! What a catch under pressure! James Rew, take a bow! This was a googly, on a length and outside off. Noor Ahmad hangs back and miscues his pull in the air towards the mid on region. James Rew runs in from long on and dives in front to take a stunner. Huge moment in this game and Rew might have just taken his side over the line here with a terrific catch.
Commentary.Howout: c James Rew b Rehan Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Rehan Ahmed to bowl the penultimate over.
Boyden goes full this time, outside off. Noor Ahmad opens the face of his bat and steers it towards deep point for a single. 19 runs needed off 12 balls.
Another slower ball, into the wicket, around off. Abdul Hadi taps it to the off side and hands the strike back to Noor Ahmad.
Play and a miss! A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Abdul Hadi shimmies down the track and looks to slog but he misses.
A low full toss, outside off. Abdul Hadi drills it straight to the man at extra cover. A precious dot ball for England Under-19!
A very wide yorker, outside off. Noor Ahmad digs it out to the off side for a single.
A slower ball, full and outside off. Abdul Hadi reaches out and looks to push it through the off side but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Joshua Boyden to bowl now.

Back of a length, around off. Abdul Hadi taps it towards point and takes off for a quick run. 20 runs off the over, just the kind of over that Afghanistan Under-19 were looking for. 23 runs needed now off 18 balls.
Banged into the deck, around off. Noor Ahmad hangs back and just helps it on its way towards deep backward square leg for a single.
A low full toss, on off. Abdul Hadi drills it towards mid off and takes a run.
SIX! WOW! What a shot this is under pressure! Good-length ball, around middle. Abdul Hadi skips down and lofts it over mid on. The ball goes well over the long on fence and it is a maximum!
On a length, around middle. Noor Ahmad taps it to the leg side and takes a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Noor Ahmad looks to pull but it goes off the top edge and in the air towards the vacant mid-wicket region. The batters take two.

NO BALL AND A BOUNDARY!  Another no ball and it races away to the fence. Horrible start for Sales. Sales errs in his line as well as length and bowls a full toss, outside off, above shoulders. The keeper fumbles and the ball races away to the third man fence.
James Sales can resume his over as it was not a dangerous one and was wide of the batter. Extraordinary scenes here. First he was told to walk off but Sales gets the ball back.
The umpire has given it as a no ball but still it is taken upstairs. The same says the third umpire and a Free-hit will follow.

No ball! Oh, dear! Absolute drama in the middle and Noor Ahmad gets a life here! James Sales has only himself to blame here! This was a slower ball, on a length, well outside off. Noor Ahmad reaches out and looks to go over cover but it goes off the top edge, high in the air towards point. George Thomas settles under it and takes it with ease. However, the umpire has signalled a no ball as James Sales has overstepped! The batters sneak in a couple of runs as well. Free hit to follow.
James Sales (4-0-28-0) is back into the attack.
Short of a length, outside off. Noor Ahmad stays back and steers it towards third man for a single. 43 runs needed off 24 balls.
A slower bumper, around leg. Noor Ahmad swivels and looks to pull hard but it goes off the inner half of the blade and to the left of the keeper. No run there!
A short ball, around off. Abdul Hadi flat-bats it towards mid off and takes a run.
On a length, around off. Abdul Hadi skips down yet again but he fails to nail his shot this time. It goes off the shoulder of his bat towards extra cover.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Good-length ball, around off. Abdul Hadi skips down the track and whacks it wide of the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Abdul Hadi looks to pull but he gets an inside edge onto the deck.
Slightly short, on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single. Good over for Afghanistan.
Full and outside off, Noor Ahmad pushes it to covers for a single.
A googly, outside off, Hadi guides it to deep point for a single.
Short again and this time Ahmad pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket with soft hands for a couple of runs. Good running.
SIX! What a shot! Half-tracker from Rehan Ahmed and Noor Ahmad pulls it all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Length and on middle, Ahmad pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Length and on leg. Hadi makes room and pushes it to mid off for a quick single.
Leg bye! Short of a length, slower and on off. Ahmad misses his pull and gets hit on the body. It rolls to covers for a leg bye.
FOUR! Much needed one! A length ball, outside off. Ahmad pulls it into the gap and beats the diving square leg fielder as well to bag a boundary.
Tad fuller, outside off, pushed to covers.
Full ball, outside off. Hadi looks to sweep but misses.
Another googly but this was outside off. Ahmad tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Noor Ahmad walks in at number 8.

OUT! TIMBER! Ijaz Ahmadzai played all around it and finally after taking some hitting Rehan Ahmed has a smile on his face! This is a googly, full and landing around off. Ijaz Ahmadzai doesn't read it as he leans and looks to work it on the leg side. He leaves a big gap and the ball goes through the gate to crash the stumps.
Tossed up, on middle, Hadi sweeps it to deep square leg for one more.
Shorter again, around off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter, and way outside off. Ijaz Ahmadzai looks to cut but misses.
Rehan Ahmed (3-0-25-0) is back on.
Length and on middle. Hadi mistimes his pull to mid on. 71 needed in 48 balls.
Length and on off, punched to covers for a single.
Length and outside off. Ijaz Ahmadzai slaps it to deep point and sweeper cover runs across and cuts it off. Two.
Short of a length, outside off. Hadi slaps it to deep point for a single.
Around off, pushed to covers.
On a length, on off. Abdul Hadi keeps it out.
Flatter and on off. Ahmadzai blocks it out.
Full and on middle. Defended out.
Ijaz Ahmadzai walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! England Under-19 get the breakthrough and at a crucial time as well! This is full and on middle. Ahmad gets across the stumps and heaves it, he gets more height than distance and hits it wide of long on. James Rew runs across to his right and takes a sharp catch. England Under-19 on top yet again!
Commentary.Howout: c James Rew b Tom Prest

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on middle. Hadi drills it to long on for a single. 50-run partnership between these two as well.
Short and on off, slapped to deep covers for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, on middle, flicked to the right of the mid-wicket and the fielder there dives to that side to stop it.

DRINKS! The game is evenly poised and we are in for a cracking finish - Afghanistan Under-19 need 78 runs from 60 balls! A couple of wickets and England Under-19 will be right on top but having said that, these two batters at the crease have done well to keep the scoreboard ticking! That dropped catch of Bilal Ahmad from Joshua Boyden could haunt England Under-19 if Bilal Ahmad keeps cruising along with his partner. Will Afghanistan Under-19 create history by sealing a spot in the finals? Well, only time shall tell.
Flatter and on off. Ahmad hits it to covers.
FOUR! Afghanistan getting back on track! Tossed up, on the pads. Bilal Ahmad tickles it fine to the fine leg fence. The fielder there gives a chase but the ball wins the race.
Short again, on middle. Ahmad makes room and cuts it to point where the fielder dives to right and stops it.
Another solid block from Ahmad.
Short and drifting on middle. Ahmad rocks back and blocks it.
Around off. Ahmad keeps it out.
THREE WIDES! Full and down the leg side. Ahmad misses his sweep. The keeper fails to collect and a couple of runs are taken.
Short and outside off, cut away through covers for a single.
On middle, pushed on the leg side.

DROPPED! Pressure is getting big here! Full and on off. Bilal Ahmad shuffles and looks to pull it but gets a top edge towards short fine leg where Joshua Boyden runs to his right and the ball pops out. A precious drop. The keeper fumbles to carry and an overthrow is taken. Two in total.
Flatter and outside off. Ahmad looks to cut but msises.
On middle. Blocked out.

NOT OUT! Around off. Hadi taps it to point and runs across for a quick single. the fielder at point throws it towards the keeper. The keeper removes the bails off but the replay shows Bilal was inside his crease.

Is that a run out? The keeper has whipped the bails off as the throw came in from point. It looked like Bilal Sami was well in though! The leg umpire has sent it upstairs and the replays roll in. It confirms that Bilal Ahmad was home before Alex Horton had whipped the bails.
Floated, fuller in length, outside off. Abdul Hadi sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter ball, on middle. Abdul Hadi punches it back to the bowler who makes a good diving stop.
Flatter ball, on middle. Bilal Ahmad clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Another ball, shorter in length, outside off. Bilal Ahmad rocks back and cuts it past the point fielder to fetch himself a boundary.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Bilal Ahmad cuts it to the man short third man.
Flatter ball, outside off. Abdul Hadi punches it to long off for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Bilal Ahmad blocks it to the off side.

DROPPED! FOUR! Terrific effort in the deep but Afghanistan Under-19 get a much-needed boundary! Tossed up, fuller in length, outside off. Bilal Ahmad reaches out and lofts it over the bowler's head without much timing. The ball goes in the air, wide of the long on fielder. James Rew runs across from long on, puts in a dive but puts it down. The ball goes past the fence for a boundary.
Fuller in length, outside off. Abdul Hadi drives it towards sweeper cover and takes a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Abdul Hadi keeps it out.
Tap and run! Flatter ball, around off. Bilal Ahmad taps it to the off side and scampers through to the other end.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Bilal Ahmad gets forward and keeps it out.
Flighted delivery, on a length, outside off. Bilal Ahmad leans and pushes it past covers for a run.
Fuller in length, outside off. Abdul Hadi works it towards long off for a single.
Floated, outside off. Abdul Hadi prods and blocks it out.
A short ball, outside off. Bilal Ahmad rocks back and cuts it uppishly towards the point region. It falls short of the backward point fielder who half-stops it and the batters take a single.
On a length, around off. Bilal Ahmad defends it to the off side.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Hadi tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off and going on with the arm. Bilal Ahmad leaves it alone.
Tossed up, on middle. Abdul Hadi drives it to long on for a run.
Slightly shorter in length, on off. Abdul Hadi cuts it over the cover fielder and comes back for the second run.

Just short of the fielder! Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Bilal Ahmad stays back to cut but it goes off the outside edge and lands just in front of the diving fielder at short third man. A single taken.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Abdul Hadi works it towards point for a quick single.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Tossed up, on a length, way outside off. Bilal Ahmad leans and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Bilal Ahmad looks to block but it goes off the inside edge and onto the pads.
Flatter ball, outside off. Bilal Ahmad stays back and guides it to backward point.
A flat googly, around middle. Bilal Ahmad is cramped for room as he tries to cut it.
FOUR! BACK-TO-BACK BOUNDARIES! A short ball, googly, around middle. Bilal Ahmad rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! Deft touch! Slightly shorter in length and outside off. Bilal Ahmad waits for it and guides it past the man at short third man for a boundary.
Rehan Ahmed comes into the attack.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
Full and on off. Defended out.
This one skids through, outside off. Hadi has a poke at it but misses.
Slightly short, on off, cut away to covers this time.
Around off, pushed to point.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out on the off side.
Angles a full ball, on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
Length and outside off. Ahmad waits and dabs it to third man for a single.
Full and outside off. Ahmad keeps it out.
A slower short ball, outside off. Ahmad looks to pull but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler.
Full and on off, pushed  to point.
Bilal Ahmad is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and this time it is the big, big wicket of Noor who was trying to change the game single-handedly. Now the pressure is well and truly on Afghanistan Under-19 as two new batters will be at the crease. This is full and outside off. Noor looks to go over mid off but does not middle it. Hits it straight to mid off where Sales takes it. End of a gutsy knock from Noor and Afghanistan Under-19 are in some serious trouble now!
Commentary.Howout: c James Sales b Tom Aspinwall

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on middle. Hadi defends it back to Prest.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
This is pushed back to the bowler.
Short and on off, cut away to point for a single.
Short and on off. Hadi punches it back to the bowler, who collects it on a bounce.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on off. Noor again looks to heave but mistimes it to mid on and a quick single is taken.
Touch fuller, outside off. Noor heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller ball, outside off. Noor shuffles and pushes it straight to covers.
Length and outside off. Noor gets behind the line and defends it out.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Short in length, on middle. Noor pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary. 100 up for Afghanistan Under-19, they lost two quick wickets but still are on top.
Fuller and on middle. Noor turns it to mid on.
Fuller and on off, pushed to the off side.
On middle. Blocked out.

An appeal for caught behind but not given! The keeper and bowler were confident but the umpire is unmoved! Flatter and outside off. Hadi presses forward to defend but misses and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Flatter and on off. Hadi guides it to point.
Tossed up, on off. Hadi gets on his knee and blocks it out.
Full and outside off. Noor powers it to long on for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Abdul Hadi cuts hard but the fielder at backward point does well to stop it by diving to his right. No run there! Afghanistan Under-19 need 136 runs off 132 balls now!
Full ball, around middle. Abdul Hadi flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Short of a length, on leg. Abdul Hadi keeps it out.
Abdul Hadi walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Tom Aspinwall strikes and Afghanistan Under-19 lose their skipper now! Two wickets in quick succession for England Under-19 and they roaring back into this contest! This was a full ball, around middle. Safi sits back and flicks it uppishly. The ball goes straight to Jacob Bethell at mid-wicket who takes a sharp catch. Huge wicket this for England Under-19!
Commentary.Howout: c Jacob Bethell b Tom Aspinwall

Commentary.Commentary: A short ball, around leg. Suliman Safi nudges it towards square leg.

Good-length ball, outside off. Allah Noor looks to drive on the up but it goes off the thick outside edge towards third man for a single. That brings up the fifty for Allah Noor! Top innings from him so far but he would be aware that the job is only half done.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off and turning in late. Suliman Safi rocks back but cuts it straight to the man at backward point.
Flighted on a length, outside off. Suliman Safi leans and drives it towards cover.
Flatter ball, outside off. Suliman Safi stays back to cut but he misses.
Suliman Safi is the new man in

OUT! RUN OUT! Allah Noor looks to sneak in a run to get to his fifty but he is denied and it is Mohammad Ishaq who has to take the long walk back to the pavilion! Tossed up, around off. Noor prods and taps it towards point. He takes off for a run but his partner, Mohammad Ishaq is a bit late to get off the blocks. Tom Aspinwall runs in from point, collects the ball and hurls an underarm throw to the keeper. Alex Horton grabs it and whips the bails off. Ishaq is well short of his crease and England Under-19 get the much-needed breakthrough!
Is that a run out? The batter is short by a long, long way. OUT is shown on the big screen and England have a breakthrough.
Fuller in length, outside off. Mohammad Ishaq drives it towards cover where the fielder fumbles and concedes a single.
Flatter ball, around middle. Allah Noor stays back and works it to long on for a single.

On a length, angling in from middle. Allah Noor pulls it behind square on the leg side without much timing for a run. Just 2 runs off the over! Afghanistan Under-19 have scored only 12 runs from the last 5 overs!
Fuller in length, outside off. Allah Noor gets low and pushes it to the man at extra cover.
Good-length ball, around middle. Allah Noor prods and pushes it back to the bowler.
Short of a length, around off. Noor looks to pull but it goes off the toe end and onto the deck.
A length ball, around middle. Mohammad Ishaq moves across in his crease and clips it wide of the fine leg fielder for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Mohammad Ishaq sits back and taps it to backward point.
Flatter ball, outside off and going on with the angle. Noor stays back to cut but he misses. Another tidy over from Bethell! Just 1 run off it!
Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Allah Noor pushes it back to the bowler.
Good running! Flatter ball, around leg. Mohammad Ishaq nudges it to the leg side and takes off for a quick run.
On a length, around off. Mohammad Ishaq keeps it out.
Tossed up, outside off. Mohammad Ishaq looks to drive but it goes off the outer half of the blade towards backward point.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Ishaq cuts it to the fielder at backward point.
A length ball, on the pads. Mohammad Ishaq tickles it towards fine leg and takes a single.
Good-length ball, on middle. Mohammad Ishaq keeps it out.

DROPPED! FOUR! That should have been taken by the keeper! A bit fuller this time, way outside off. Ishaq reaches out and looks to heave it across the line. It takes the outside egde and goes just over the keeper. Alex Horton hops but does not hold onto it and it goes past him for a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Allah Noor punches it past the fielder at cover and takes a single.
A short ball, around leg, cramping the batter for room. Ishaq swivels and helps it on its way towards fine leg for a run.
Back of a length, angling in from outside off. Mohammad Ishaq looks to heave it away but he misses.
On off, this is hit straight to covers.
Tossed up again. Noor looks to defend but it goes off the outer half of the bat to point.
Tossed up, on off. Noor prods and defends it out.
Shorter and on off. Noor punches it to covers.
On middle. Allah Noor blocks it out.
Flatter and on off, pushed to covers.

DRINKS! Afghanistan Under-19 have done a fine job so far and the batters at the crease have made sure that they are keeping up with the required run rate. England Under-19 need some wickets badly to put the pressure back on Afghanistan Under-19. Mohammad Ishaq and Allah Noor will look to bat deep and get as close to the target as possible. England Under-19 will have to make the play from hereon.
On middle. Ishaq pulls it hard to short mid-wicket where the fielder dives to his right and stops it. Just two off it then!
Around off, pushed to covers.
Short of a length, on middle. Ishaq mistimes his pull on the leg side.
Length and outside off. Ishaq hops and defends it out.
Length and outside off. Ishaq looks to cut but misses.
Good running! Fuller and on middle. Ishaq flicks it t o deep square leg. They come back for two runs and make it easily.
Tom Aspinwall comes to bowl. He replaces Rehan Ahmed.
Four dots on trot! Shorter and on off. Noor keeps it out.
Around off. Noor works it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off, Noor leans and hits it to cover.
On middle. Noor lunges and blocks it.
A single as this is pushed down to long off.
Flighted and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
SIX! What a shot! Short and on middle. Allah Noor pulls it flat but enough to clear the mid-wicket fence. With ease.
Shorter and on middle. Ishaq bunts it to mid-wicket for one run.
Full and on middle. Ishaq sweeps it straight to square leg.
On middle, tucked away to square leg for a single.
Flatter and on middle, defended out.
Short ball, it stays low off the deck, on off. Ishaq flicks it uppishly and wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Tidy over from Jacob Bethell! On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket.
This is slightly short, on middle, pushed to the right of the bowler who puts in a dive to stop it.
Tossed up, on off. Noor keeps it out.
Tossed up, on off, an easy single as this is drilled down to long off.
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked out.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
A half-tracker, around middle. Allah Noor rocks back and mistimes his pull towards deep mid-wicket for only a single.
Flatter and quicker, on a length, around middle. Mohammad Ishaq whips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Allah Noor drives it down to long off for a single.
A quicker ball, on a length and going on with the arm. Ishaq stays back and whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
On a length, outside off. Mohammad Ishaq hangs back and punches it to cover.

Whooaa! That stayed very low! A short ball, around off. Mohammad Ishaq rocks back and waits for it. He looks to whack it across the line but he misses as the ball stays low and gets hit low on his pad.
On a length, around middle. Noor stays back and tucks it towards mid-wicket. The fielder there dives to his right and stops a single.
Flatter and quicker, around middle. Mohammad Ishaq nudges it past mid-wicket and collects a run.
Tossed up, around middle. Mohammad Ishaq turns it to the fielder at mid-wicket.

SIX! BANG! Mohammad Ishaq breaks the shackles! Slower through the air, on a length, around middle. Ishaq backs away and tonks it over the long on region for a biggie. That would ease some nerves of the batter.
On a length, around middle. Allah Noor bunts it behind square on the leg side and takes off for a run.
Flatter ball, outside off and turning in late. Allah Noor looks to defend but gets an inside edge and onto the deck.
Tossed up, around off. Allah Noor nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single to end the over.
Flighted delivery, full and on off. Allah Noor keeps it out watchfully.
Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Allah Noor rocks back and dabs it onto the deck.
On a length, darted on the pads. Allah Noor tucks it towards square leg.
An appeal for LBW but turned down! A full ball, going on with the angle from middle. Noor clears his front leg and looks to defend but he misses and gets hit low on his pad.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
Looped up, on a length, outside off. Mohammad Ishaq prods and pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated, fuller in length, outside off. Ishaq leans and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up, around off. Mohammad Ishaq gets forward and blocks it out.
On a length, darted on the pads. Allah Noor nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Allah Noor looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge past the short third man fielder for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, on middle. Mohammad Ishaq works it to long on and takes a run.
Fuller in length, around middle. Allah Noor prods and pushes it back to the bowler. A tidy start from Jacob Bethell!
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Allah Noor stays back and taps it to the off side.
Tossed up, around middle and spinning away late. Allah Noor stays back to block but he misses and gets hit high on his pad.
On a length, around leg. Ishaq nudges it to the leg side for a single and that brings the 50-run stand between these two!
A quicker ball, on a length, on middle and going on with the arm. Ishaq tries to block but he misses and gets hit on his pad.
Bethell starts with a flatter ball, on middle. Ishaq taps it to the leg side.
End of Powerplay 1! England Under-19 can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 37th over.

FOUR! Just over square leg! This was short and on middle. Noor hangs back and pulls it to square leg. The fielder there leaps to his right but it goes over him and into the fence. 50 up as well for Afghanistan Under-19.
Tossed up, on off. Ishaq wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and on off. Ishaq leans and flicks it to mid-wicket.
On middle. Blocked out.
Tossed up, on off. Ishaq sweeps it nicely but straight to square leg.
Prest starts with a fuller delivery, outside off. Ishaq pushes it to covers.
England Under-19 skipper, Tom Prest brings himself into the attack.
Length and outside off. Noor punches off the back foot to covers.
FOUR! Wonderful use of the wrists! A length ball, on middle. Noor turns it wide of square leg for another boundary.
Fuller now, on off, pushed to covers, straight to the man there.
Around off, on a length. Noor prods and defends it out.
Length and on middle, tucked to square leg.
Length ball, outside off. Noor slaps it late towards point. Cannot find the gap there.

A short ball, angling down leg. Alex Horton swivels and just helps it on its way towards fine leg for a single. It would have been another boundary had the ball been hit a couple of metres on the either side of that fielder. Great over for Afghanistan Under-19 as 16 runs came off it!
Fuller in length, angling in from middle. Allah Noor prods and pushes it towards mid on.
SIX! This is turning out to be an expensive over! Full ball, outside off. Noor gets low and powers it over long off for a biggie.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries but this is a more authoritative shot! Length and on middle. Noor shows full face of the bat and smacks it straight down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Makes full use of it. A short ball, on middle. Noor skips down a bit and hammers it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
NO BALL! A full toss, way above the chest. Noor swings and misses. The umpire calls it as a no ball for the height and free-hit is coming up.
Touch fuller and on middle, pushed to mid on.
On off, Defended out.
On middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! Length and on middle. Ishaq pulls it nicely and towards deep square leg for a boundary. Beats the fielder as well.
Outside off, on a length. Ishaq taps it to point.
Slower ball, on the body. Ishaq looks to pull but gets hit on the body.

Length ball, outside off. Noor gets an outside edge as he looks to cut it, the ball rolls to third man for a single. The keeper is standing up behind the wickets, so Allah Noor has to stay back in his crease.
Full ball, swinging in, around off, Ishaq hits it back to bowler.

Slight halt in play. Allah Noor gets hit on his right shoulder as the fielder at mid-wicket threw the ball straight at him. The physio is out to have a check on him. He seems fine and we are good to go!
Length and on middle. Ishaq pulls it to square leg.
Slight hesitation but no harm done. On middle, this is hit to mid on. Ishaq and Noor have a yes, no moment but in the end, they settle without a single.

FOUR! Intent from Mohammad Ishaq! He is playing some wonderful shots! A full ball, on off. Ishaq whacks it in the air and towards mid-wicket, the ball takes a couple of bounces before racing to the fence.
On middle, on a length. Ishaq gets behind the line of the ball to block it out.
Length and on off. Ishaq takes a step across and defends it out.
Uppish but safe! Good-length ball, just outside off. Allah Noor drives it uppishly through the mid off region. The ball goes to the fielder there, on the bounce. A maiden over from Boyden!
Short of a length, around off and angling across the batter. Allah Noor stays back and taps it to the off side.
Change of pace from Boyden! A slower ball, fuller in length, around off. Allah Noor presses forward to block it out.
Good-length ball, outside off and angling across the batter. Allah Noor sits back in his crease and leaves it alone.
A full ball, outside off. Allah Noor reaches out and digs it out towards cover.
Back of a length, around off. Allah Noor defends it to the off side.
Another ball, banged into the deck, around middle. Mohammad Ishaq goes for a pull this time but he does not manage to get any bat to it.
A short ball, around off. Mohammad Ishaq ducks underneath.
A full ball, around leg. Allah Noor digs it out and it goes off the inside edge behind square on the leg side for a single.
SIX! WHOOAA! That is some way to get off the mark! A length delivery, around off. Noor stands tall and tonks it way over the long on fence to bag a maximum. Top shot!
An appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire! A yorker-length delivery, around middle. Allah Noor looks to dig it out but he misses and gets hit low on his pad. Might have gone down leg.
Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Allah Noor turns it to mid-wicket.
On a length, around off. Mohammad Ishaq presses forward and keeps it out.

SIX! WOW! Take that, says Mohammad Ishaq! Boyden serves it on the pads and the length is on the fuller side. Mohammad Ishaq prods and whips it behind square on the leg side. The ball goes all the way over deep square leg fence for a maximum.
Another full ball, around middle. Mohammad Ishaq lunges and eases it soft hands towards mid on.
Wide! Boyden errs in line and spills this one down leg. Mohammad Ishaq misses his flick and the umpire calls it as a wide.
On a length, angling in from middle. Mohammad Ishaq prods and turns it towards mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Full ball, outside off and curling away late. Mohammad Ishaq looks for a drive but the ball beats his outside edge.
Full ball, outside off. Mohammad Ishaq presses forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Fuller in length, around off. Allah Noor leans and pushes it towards mid on. A dot to end the over.
A length ball, angling in from middle. Allah Noor prods and tucks it to the leg side. He wanted a run but is wisely sent back by Ishaq.
Good-length delivery, around off. Allah Noor blocks it to the off side.
On a length, shaping away outside off. Allah Noor lets it through to the keeper.
Full ball, well outside off. Allah Noor leaves it alone.
Back of a length, around leg. Mohammad Ishaq stays back and dabs it behind square on the leg side for a run.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is James Sales.
Boyden goes fuller this time, around middle. Allah Noor lunges and drives it on the up towards mid on. No run there! Just 1 run and a wicket off the first over! Top start for England Under-19!
Full ball, outside off. Allah Noor prods and pushes it towards backward point.
Good-length ball, around leg. Allah Noor stays back and turns it to mid-wicket.
Allah Noor walks out at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED! Joshua Boyden strikes early and England Under-19 are off to a dream start! Boyden serves a length ball, around off that goes on with the angle. Nangeyalia Kharote looks to drive on the up but he misses it completely. The ball sneaks through his bat and rattles the off stump. What a tournament Boyden is having!
Length ball, way outside off. Nangeyalia Kharote leaves it alone.
Boyden starts with a length ball, angling in from middle. Mohammad Ishaq clips it behind square on the leg side and takes a single. Ishaq and Afghanistan Under-19 are up and running straightaway!
